claim: Native skfolio 1.2.9 produced 20 chronological development folds and one reserved 2021Q1 evaluation with 21 frozen selections and 6605 retained candidate records. All training label exits precede their evaluation cutoff; nine bundled LEAN source hashes remained unchanged. This is a raw-price label study, not new LEAN execution or portfolio P&L.

input_role.lean: Pinned bundled daily, map and factor files only; native engine was not executed in this wave.
input_role.pandas: Native indexed session frame passed to skfolio splitter.
input_role.skfolio: Installed upstream WalkForward called on chronological session rows with 252/63/6 and reduce_test=True.

frozen_plan.before: Parsing or scoring prices; each selection is exclusively persisted before its evaluation labels are materialized.

setup_history: Initial compile/sync also included unused DuckDB 1.5.5. It was removed, the 19-distribution lock rebuilt without host-path header, and environment synced before any scoring. Those preparatory output streams are retained in private_artifacts; no working SDK mutation occurred.
limitations: Selected ETF sample, not point-in-time equity universe, catalyst/extreme-mover strategy or proof of data rights/original availability.
Raw prices include ex-dividend moves but omit distributions; price labels are not total returns. Studied factor rows have constant split factor 1 and map intervals preserve each symbol.

Fixed 20bp round-trip cost proxy per invested episode does not model fills, commissions, funding, turnover netting, liquidity or capacity. No cash/position/fee/dividend reconciliation or new LEAN engine execution.
Arithmetic five-session labels are not compounded/annualized portfolio performance. Only 11 complete reserved episodes per candidate; no statistical alpha, safety, superiority or promotion claim.
Reserved 2021Q1 means held separate for this protocol, not globally unseen historical data. It is now inspected evidence; subsequent reuse cannot be called untouched.

Development labels can cross 63-session fold boundaries within development, while earlier selections use only completed prior labels. A six-row gap plus interval assertions does not prove independent samples.
Input hashes establish byte identity, not independent source attestation. Annual counts/aligned calendars do not prove complete market coverage.
Native acceptance is this Linux/WSL Python 3.13.15 environment. macOS and fresh hosts still need their own dependency and execution acceptance.

independent_review.scope: Read-only independent code and evidence review; no scoring rerun or new label calculation.
